The claim states that if S_max is too low for a feasible solution, the algorithm results in the lowest detail level being specified for all blocks. Source [S1] explicitly states in Section 3.7.1: 'When the Smax constraint is too low for a feasible solution, it gracefully results in the lowest detail level being specified for all blocks.' Additionally, the algorithm description initializes S_total based on LOD level 1 (the lowest detail level) and only increases the LOD level if the size constraint allows. Therefore, if the constraint cannot be met even with the lowest detail levels, the algorithm retains the lowest detail level assignments.
